description: This file defines the interface IBasketViewModelService, which specifies methods for basket-related operations such as retrieving or creating a basket for a user, counting items, and mapping basket entities to view models.

methods.name: GetOrCreateBasketForUser
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves or creates a basket for the specified user.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Asynchronously counts the total number of items in the user's basket.

methods.name: Map
methods.description: Maps a Basket entity to a BasketViewModel asynchronously.
